summary: By default controller picks any instance group with capacity; instance groups set on the job template, then the inventory, then the organization (via project) override that, and a job with associated groups stays pending if they are all full unless the default group is also associated.
questions: In what order does controller choose an instance group for a job?
Why is my job stuck pending when instance groups are full?
Does a job template instance group take precedence over the inventory's?
How do I use the default instance group as a fallback?

answer_card.title: Instance group precedence for a job
answer_card.answer_md:
When a job launches, controller tries instance groups associated with, in order:

1. Job template
2. Inventory
3. Organization (by way of project)

If all associated groups are out of capacity, the job stays **pending**; it does not fall back to any instance. Associate the global `default` group too (for example on the inventory) if you want a fallback.
